featured_reviews.review_text:
I am absolutely thrilled to share my outstanding experience with Dr.Tabish Mansuri and Dr. Khushbu Ratnani for my braces treatment. From start to finish, the entire journey has been nothing short of remarkable.

Dr.Tabish Mansuri and their team have always been incredibly welcoming and professional. From the initial consultation to the final appointment, I felt confident that I was in the best hands. Their expertise and attention to detail are evident in every aspect of their practice. They took the time to explain every step of the process, addressing all my concerns and ensuring I was comfortable and informed throughout my treatment.

Dr. Khushbu Ratnani is a true master of their craft. They meticulously planned and executed my orthodontic treatment with precision and care. Their dedication to achieving the best possible outcome for me was evident at every appointment. The transformation of my smile has been beyond my expectations. I can hardly believe the difference – my teeth are perfectly aligned, and I have the wonderful smile I've always dreamed of.

The level of care and attention to detail from both Dr. Tabish Mansuri and Dr.  Khushbu Ratnani was exceptional. They made sure I was comfortable at all times and provided helpful tips and guidance to make the process as smooth as possible. Their staff is equally amazing – always friendly, efficient, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure a positive experience.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Tabish Mansuri and Dr. Khushbu Ratnani to anyone in need of dental and orthodontic care. Their commitment to excellence, combined with their compassionate approach, has made my braces journey a pleasant and rewarding experience. Thanks to them, I now have a beautiful smile that I am proud to show off!

Thank you, Dr. Tabish Mansuri and Dr. Khushbu Ratnani, for giving me the gift of a perfect smile.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: The thought of visiting a dentist is scary for most of us. One of the lesser known dentists in the area, but the one you'd definitely want to get treated from. My experience with him has been during the lockdown for my root canal, which is the most riskiest time to visit a dentist. Dr. Tabish made sure he would fully sanitize his clinic each time a patient arrived and made it extremely comfortable for his patients to trust him with hygiene and his measurements for the prevention. When most dentists had been shut, he had been risking his life constantly to be there for the ones that needed his medical help. He finished my root canal in lesser sittings to avoid unnecessary travel during the pandemic. His immense knowledge in the field and extreme professionalism and care made the process of a scary sounding root canal very smooth and pain free. His guidance throughout the procedure has been of a caring dentist who would explain the what's and why's and talk you through the process with ease. I highly recommend him to those seeking a smooth and non scary dental procedures that would put a beautiful smile on your face.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been visiting Dr. Chang for the past several years, and I can confidently say that he is the best! From my very first visit to now, the experience has always been exceptional. The staff is incredibly helpful and accommodating, always making sure appointments fit my schedule.

One thing that has never changed is Dr. Chang’s soft and gentle touch. I hardly feel any discomfort during procedures, which is rare to find in a dentist. Beyond regular dental care, Dr. Chang has also helped me with my recurring tonsil stones, which have caused me severe pain over several months now. I truly appreciate the kindness, professionalism, and outstanding service from Dr. Chang and the entire team at Dr. M.K. Changs Dental Clinic. If you’re looking for a dentist who genuinely cares, goes above and beyond, and ensures a pain-free experience, I highly recommend him!

featured_reviews.review_text: I had visited Dr. Chang's clinic for an RCT and the filling of 3 caries. The dental work itself was swift and as painless as possible. He took great care when filling the caries on my incisors, working on each tooth meticulously, and as for the RCT, it was my least painful experience so far. As I'm not going to be in Mumbai for long and I still have a few other teeth-related things to be fixed, he kindly gave me advice on things to be particular/careful about so that I'm as informed as a patient should be. He's a true doctor!

owner_posts.post_text: Oral hygiene is extremely important. This is how your brush will tell you whether you are brushing too hard or too soft.

Do tongue scrapers actually work? Yes. And once you understand what they're removing, you'll never skip it again. Your tongue isn't smooth. It's covered in microscopic folds, Grooves, and papilli, and every single one of them traps bacteria, dead cells, and food particles overnight. When you brush your tongue, you're not cleaning it. A toothbrush is designed for hard enamel surfaces. On soft tissue, it just pushes everything around. Same bacteria area, different location. A tongue scraper does something completely different. That single drag from back to front lifts the biofilm, the actual layer sitting on your tongue, and removes it entirely. You can see it on the scraper. That's what was living in your mouth. Dentists have recommended tongue scrapers for decades. They cost almost nothing, and most people have never used one. Your toothbrush was never designed to clean your tongue. That's not its job. This is.

*Gum Disease Is More Than a Mouth Problem*  
Many people think gum disease only affects their teeth and gums, but the danger runs deeper. The bacteria responsible don't stay confined to your mouth. They can enter your bloodstream through inflamed gum tissue and travel throughout your body, potentially contributing to serious health issues like heart disease, diabetes complications, and other systemic conditions. Your oral health is directly connected to your overall health, making regular dental care and gum disease prevention critical for your entire body.
